title: Disable Fcitx5 overriding XKB settings
summary: Prevent Fcitx5 from overriding your system keyboard layout settings (XKB). Useful if you want to manage keyboard layouts via setxkbmap or your desktop environment instead.

steps.explain: Navigate to Addons > XCB and uncheck 'Allow Overriding System XKB Settings'.
steps.gui: In Fcitx5 Configuration: Go to 'Addons', select 'XCB', and uncheck 'Allow Overriding System XKB Settings'.
